title: Shakira Adds Five New U.S. Dates to 2026 Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour: See Full Schedule
summary: The additional nights added are in San Jose, Atlanta, Miami, Boston and Brooklyn.
contentText:
Following her historic performances in Brazil over the weekend — which drew an estimated two million people to Copacabana Beach in Rio de Janeiro — Shakira announced on Tuesday (May 5) five additional U.S. dates for her Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran World Tour.

Due to overwhelming demand, the limited U.S. run offers fans another chance to experience the production in more intimate arena settings this summer, with additional nights added in San Jose, Calif. Atlanta, Miami, Boston and Brooklyn.

Tickets for the newly added dates will be available starting with Citi and Verizon presales on Thursday (May 7). Artist presale will follow on Friday (May 8) at 10 a.m. local time, with the general onsale opening Monday (May 11) at 10 a.m. local time via shakira.com . The tour will also offer a variety of different VIP packages. For more information, visit  vipnation.com .

Outside the U.S., the self-proclaimed She-Wolf is taking her tour global with the announcement of a new residency in Madrid this fall . The shows will be held at the “Shakira Stadium” in Macondo Park, a temporary, 50,000 capacity pop-up. See those dates here .
